package outsiderefuted

import framework.dsl.*
import framework.dsl.Finite.given
import framework.dsl.outcomes.Outcome

object RefutationFixture:
  var calls = Vector.empty[String]
  def observed(label: String): Boolean =
    calls :+= label
    true
  class Model(multiple: Boolean = false) extends Machine[Outcome, Nothing]:
    var count = if multiple then oneOf(Vector(0, 1)) else 0
    object client extends Actor:
      lazy val increment = action
    object transitions extends Transitions:
      on(client.increment):
        if count < 1 then effects.increment()
    object effects:
      def increment(): Unit = count += 1
      def leak(): Unit = count += 2
    object invariants:
      val bounded =
        check(observed("claim") && count <= 1)
  val instance = new Model
  class BudgetSuite(instance: Model) extends ModelSuite(instance):
    object changed extends Derived(model.rebind(on(model.client.increment):
      if model.count < 2 then model.effects.leak()
    ))
    object examples:
      test("budgeted replay"):
        model.client.increment()
        expect(model.count == 1)
    object explorations:
      val space = explore(steps = 2):
        model.client.increment
      test("budgeted find"):
        space.find(steps = 1):
          expect(model.count == 99)
      test("budgeted sample"):
        space.sample(2, seed = 2L)
      test("budgeted refutation"):
        refuted(changed, model.invariants.bounded)

class PublicRefutationSuite extends ModelSuite(RefutationFixture.instance):
  object changed extends Derived(model.rebind(on(model.client.increment):
    if model.count < 2 then model.effects.leak()
  ))
  object examples:
    test("ordinary example"):
      model.client.increment()
      expect(model.count == 1)
  object explorations:
    val space = explore(steps = 2):
      model.client.increment
    test("find adjacent to refutation"):
      space.find(steps = 1):
        expect(model.count == 1)
    test("sample adjacent to refutation"):
      space.sample(2, seed = 2L)
    test(munit.TestOptions("a changed machine breaks the original named claim")):
      refuted(changed, model.invariants.bounded)

class RefutationClientTest extends munit.FunSuite:
  private def run(suite: munit.FunSuite): org.junit.runner.Result =
    new org.junit.runner.JUnitCore().run(
      org.junit.runner.Request.runner(new munit.MUnitRunner(suite.getClass, suite))
    )

  test("public refutation registers inertly and executes beside find sample and replay"):
    RefutationFixture.calls = Vector.empty
    val suite = new PublicRefutationSuite
    assertEquals(suite.munitTests().size, 5)
    assertEquals(suite.munitTests().size, 5)
    assertEquals(RefutationFixture.calls, Vector.empty)
    sys.props.get("refuted.library").foreach: library =>
      val origin = java.nio.file.Path.of(suite.explorations.space.getClass.getProtectionDomain.getCodeSource.getLocation.toURI)
      assertEquals(origin.toRealPath().toString, java.nio.file.Path.of(library).toRealPath().toString)
    val result = run(suite)
    assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 5)
    if sys.props.contains("refuted.declarations-only") then
      assert(Option(getClass.getClassLoader.getResource("framework/checker/Native$.class")).isEmpty)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 5)
      assert(result.getFailures.toArray.forall(_.toString.contains("native execution requires the product checker module")))
      assertEquals(RefutationFixture.calls, Vector.empty)
    else
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 0, result.getFailures.toString)
      assert(RefutationFixture.calls.nonEmpty)
      assertEquals(suite.model.count, 0)

  test("verified and budget unknown cannot satisfy the negative control"):
    if !sys.props.contains("refuted.declarations-only") then
      val instance = new RefutationFixture.Model
      class Holding extends ModelSuite(instance):
        object explorations:
          test("holding is no refutation"):
            refuted(model, model.invariants.bounded)
      val holding = run(new Holding)
      assertEquals(holding.getRunCount, 2)
      assertEquals(holding.getFailureCount, 1)
      assert(holding.getFailures.toString.contains("verified"))
      val suite = new RefutationFixture.BudgetSuite(new RefutationFixture.Model)
      assertEquals(suite.getClass.getName, "outsiderefuted.RefutationFixture$BudgetSuite")
      val cut = run(suite)
      assertEquals(cut.getRunCount, 5)
      assertEquals(cut.getFailureCount, 5)
      val failures = cut.getFailures.toArray.toVector.map(_.toString)
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("unknown")), failures.mkString("\n"))
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("budget 1 states")), failures.mkString("\n"))
      assertEquals(suite.model.count, 0)

  test("all question carriers refuse reuse by another suite even over the same Model"):
    if !sys.props.contains("refuted.declarations-only") then
      val source = new PublicRefutationSuite
      val _ = source.munitTests()
      class Borrower extends ModelSuite(source.model):
        object explorations:
          test("borrowed find"):
            source.explorations.space.find(steps = 1):
              expect(true)
          test("borrowed sample"):
            source.explorations.space.sample(1, seed = 1L)
          test("borrowed refutation"):
            source.refuted(source.changed, source.model.invariants.bounded)
      val result = run(new Borrower)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 4)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 3)
      val failures = result.getFailures.toArray.toVector.map(_.toString)
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("another ModelSuite instance")), failures.mkString("\n"))
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("ExplorationRefusals.test.scala:")))
      assertEquals(source.model.count, 0)

  test("same-class foreign Models and named claims refuse at their authored operations"):
    if !sys.props.contains("refuted.declarations-only") then
      val instance = new RefutationFixture.Model
      val other = new RefutationFixture.Model
      class Foreign extends ModelSuite(instance):
        object explorations:
          test("foreign Model"):
            refuted(other, model.invariants.bounded)
          test("foreign claim"):
            refuted(model, other.invariants.bounded)
      val result = run(new Foreign)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 3)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 2)
      val failures = result.getFailures.toArray.toVector.map(_.toString)
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("another Model instance")), failures.mkString("\n"))
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("ExplorationRefusals.test.scala:")))
      assertEquals(instance.count, 0)
      assertEquals(other.count, 0)

  test("refutation takes a deferred test-level start and refuses a missing multi-start selection"):
    val instance = new RefutationFixture.Model(multiple = true)
    class Starts extends ModelSuite(instance):
      var acquisitions = 0
      def selected: State =
        acquisitions += 1
        model.init.copy(count = 0)
      object changed extends Derived(model.rebind(on(model.client.increment):
        if model.count < 2 then model.effects.leak()
      ))
      object explorations:
        test("selected start", from = selected):
          refuted(changed, model.invariants.bounded)
        test("missing start"):
          refuted(changed, model.invariants.bounded)
    val suite = new Starts
    assertEquals(suite.munitTests().size, 3)
    assertEquals(suite.acquisitions, 0)
    if !sys.props.contains("refuted.declarations-only") then
      val result = run(suite)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 3)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 1)
      assert(result.getFailures.toString.contains("a refutation with several starts requires from"))
      assert(result.getFailures.toString.contains("ExplorationRefusals.test.scala:"))
      assertEquals(suite.acquisitions, 1)
      assertEquals(instance.count, 0)

  test("local exploration grammar has located refusals beside the admitted public suite"):
    import scala.compiletime.testing.typeCheckErrors
    inline val prefix = """
      import framework.dsl.*
      import framework.dsl.Finite.given
      import outsiderefuted.RefutationFixture.*
    """
    val refused = Vector(
      "any outside" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + "val bad = any"),
      "find in examples" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object explorations:
            val space = explore(1) { any }
          object examples:
            test("bad") { explorations.space.find(1) { expect(true) } }
      """),
      "sample in examples" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object explorations:
            val space = explore(1) { any }
          object examples:
            test("bad") { explorations.space.sample(1, seed = 1L) }
      """),
      "refuted in examples" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object examples:
            test("bad") { refuted(model, model.invariants.bounded) }
      """),
      "altered claim" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          def bad = refuted(model, { model.invariants.bounded; () })
      """),
      "aliased Unit" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          val alias = model.invariants.bounded
          def bad = refuted(model, alias)
      """),
      "Boolean claim" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          def bad = refuted(model, model.count == 0)
      """),
      "prefix before refuted" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object explorations:
            test("bad") { model.count = 99; refuted(model, model.invariants.bounded) }
      """),
      "missing question" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object explorations:
            test("bad") { expect(true) }
      """),
      "empty target" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object explorations:
            val space = explore(1) { any }
          def bad = explorations.space.find(1) { expect {} }
      """),
      "nonBoolean target" -> typeCheckErrors(prefix + """
        class S extends ModelSuite(instance):
          object explorations:
            val space = explore(1) { any }
          def bad = explorations.space.find(1) { expect(1) }
      """)
    )
    val diagnostics = Map(
      "any outside" -> "any is only available in an exploration space",
      "find in examples" -> "find and sample belong in explorations",
      "sample in examples" -> "find and sample belong in explorations",
      "refuted in examples" -> "find and sample belong in explorations",
      "altered claim" -> "refuted takes an exact named invariant or postcondition",
      "aliased Unit" -> "refuted takes an exact named invariant or postcondition",
      "Boolean claim" -> "refuted takes an exact named invariant or postcondition",
      "prefix before refuted" -> "an exploration test requires one find or sample question",
      "missing question" -> "an exploration test requires one find or sample question",
      "empty target" -> "expect requires bare Boolean statements",
      "nonBoolean target" -> "expect requires bare Boolean statements"
    )
    refused.foreach: (label, errors) =>
      assert(errors.exists(_.message.contains(diagnostics(label))), label + errors.toString)
      assert(errors.forall(_.lineContent.nonEmpty), label + errors.toString)
      assert(!errors.exists(_.message.contains("Exception occurred while executing macro expansion")), label + errors.toString)
